issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect a measurement function named 'dd_measure_all', but the template defines it as 'measure_all_dd'. This naming mismatch is structural: students implementing the template as-is will not provide the expected symbol (dd_measure_all) and will be confused when tests or later code reference dd_measure_all. The inconsistency makes it unclear which function name to implement and will cause import/test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function 'measure_all_dd' to 'dd_measure_all' (matching the problem statement and solution), or update the problem statement and solution to use 'measure_all_dd' consistently. Ensure the function signature and docstring remain the same when renaming.
